directive: Q06 forensic analysis — GST/tax divergence between gst_service.get_gst_report and NightAuditService.tax_snapshot (FI-10)
analysis_type: read-only forensic, no application/source/db/governance file modified
existing_evidence_cited: verification/evidence/20260910_phase2_entry/PRODUCTION_READINESS_INVENTORY.md (finding FI-10, line 115 'Q06 GST divergence on production')
verification/replay/ledger.py lines 222-262 (_tax(): tax.taxable_base_raw vs tax.taxable_base_deduplicated, explicitly labelled Q06 in its own comment)

dataset.app_boot: create_app() with DATABASE_URL pointed at the disposable copy only, TESTING=True, following verification/evidence/20260910_retention_control/verify_retention.py's pattern

formulas.path_a_get_gst_report_total_taxable: sum(TaxLine.taxable_amount), deduplicated by key=(reservation_id, charge_source_type, charge_source_id), each key counted once (app/gst_service.py:705,712-716)
formulas.path_a_get_gst_report_total_tax: sum(TaxLine.tax_amount) grouped by tax_type (CGST+SGST+IGST), no dedup needed (app/gst_service.py:717-724)
formulas.path_b_tax_snapshot_total_taxable: sum(TaxLine.taxable_amount) over ALL rows, no dedup key (app/night_audit_service.py:1136) — THE BUG
formulas.path_b_tax_snapshot_total_tax: sum(TaxLine.tax_amount) over ALL rows, no dedup needed, correct (app/night_audit_service.py:1137)
formulas.why_taxable_amount_needs_dedup_but_tax_a: gst_service._build_tax_lines (app/gst_service.py:300-339) stores the FULL unsplit taxable_amount on BOTH the CGST row and the SGST row of an intrastate charge (kwargs_base shared), but each row's tax_amount is already only that row's own correctly-split half-rate share — so tax_amount sums correctly without dedup while taxable_amount does not.

exact_divergence_point.code: total_taxable = sum(_f(t.taxable_amount) for t in self._tax_lines)
exact_divergence_point.defect: Sums taxable_amount over every TaxLine row with no deduplication by (reservation_id, charge_source_type, charge_source_id). Since every intrastate charge produces two TaxLine rows (CGST + SGST) that each carry the FULL taxable_amount, the straight sum double-counts the taxable base of every non-IGST, non-exempt charge. On this dataset (100% intrastate charges) this yields an exact, universal 2.0000x inflation.

correct_reference_implementation.pattern: seen_sources = set(); key = (reservation_id, charge_source_type, charge_source_id); add taxable_amount only if key not yet seen

exact_divergence_point.scope_of_defect: Confined to tax_snapshot()'s total_taxable field and the 'taxable' sub-value inside each by_rate bucket. total_tax, total_lines, exempt_lines, and every other NightAuditService section (including final_control's reconciliation, which uses revenue_summary()['tax_amount'] — a correct, non-doubled sum) are unaffected.

classification_options_considered.Q06-A_intentional_semantic_difference: REJECTED — no docstring/comment/naming indicates total_taxable is deliberately a different metric; total_tax agrees exactly between both paths, which it would not if the two aggregates were built on genuinely different definitions.
classification_options_considered.Q06-B_one_implementation_incorrect: ACCEPTED — NightAuditService.tax_snapshot()'s total_taxable (and by_rate[...].taxable in aggregate) is a straightforward missing-deduplication bug; gst_service.get_gst_report is correct.
classification_options_considered.Q06-C_both_correct_different_metrics: REJECTED — total_tax matching exactly between the two paths proves they are measuring the same underlying day's activity, not different business concepts; a genuine metric difference would not produce identical total_tax while total_taxable diverges by exactly 2x.
classification_options_considered.Q06-D_insufficient_evidence: REJECTED — the divergence is mechanically reproduced from source on live data down to individual TaxLine row IDs, with a clean single-line arithmetic explanation and a consistent, exact 2.0000x ratio across both available production dates.

fix_boundary.change_description: Deduplicate taxable_amount accumulation by (reservation_id, charge_source_type, charge_source_id) before adding to total_taxable, mirroring gst_service.get_gst_report's seen_sources pattern (app/gst_service.py:705,712-716) and gst_service.get_folio_gst_summary's identical pattern (app/gst_service.py:645-651). Apply equivalent dedup to the taxable component inside the by_rate loop. Secondary open question for the same fix: whether tax_snapshot() should also apply the legacy room_rent-ExtraCharge duplicate filter that get_gst_report applies (app/gst_service.py:689-702) — moot on the dataset examined (zero such rows) but a second latent divergence source on datasets carrying pre-fix duplicate rows.

founder_authorization_reason: total_taxable is a production-visible figure inside the Night Audit document and is captured into audit snapshots/verification ledgers; changing it changes what already-run night audits would show if regenerated, and a Founder should confirm no downstream report/export/GSTR workflow reads tax_snapshot()['total_taxable'] expecting the current (buggy) value before any fix is implemented.

reproduction_script.location_status: left in place under verification/_work/, which is gitignored (.gitignore: 'verification/_work/') and documented as a disposable working area; safe to delete at any time, not required for any downstream process
